source_artifact.title: HOU @ UTA 2025/11/30 - Period:1, Clock:01:35.0, Jusuf Nurkic, Rebound -

purpose: Second source state for a strict shared-optical-centre Broadcast test. This state is not allowed to promote the camera unless the joint two-state solve independently satisfies every v90 gate.

court_region_homography_from_frame_c.method: SIFT source-pixel matches in a broad court-region mask, Lowe ratio 0.72, 2 px RANSAC; dynamic-player matches are treated only as outliers and are not metric anchors
court_region_homography_from_frame_c.provenance_guardrail: The homography is source-image evidence used to transfer regulation floor-line observations into this second optical state. It is not a camera-solver output. v90 recomputes the homography from the two immutable source images and fails if the source evidence no longer reproduces.

target_annotation_policy: Native 960x540 source pixels only. Samples follow the source-visible centre of the same 2-inch white target stripe line families used by v87. No solver projection, floor homography transfer, player/ball geometry or generated pixel was used to place these elevated target samples.
rim_annotation_policy: Native source pixels only. Samples trace only the clearly visible left/upper inside orange rim contour. The orange basketball/occluded right side at larger x is excluded. Rim samples are held out of every v90 fit and are used only for independent basket-depth validation.
